Here's a description of the line plots, following your instructions:

The plots illustrate the training rewards over a series of steps for different models. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps," which is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at every 100 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.4, with tick labels at every 0.2. The first plot displays the training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" (cyan, circle markers, solid line) and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" (red, square markers, solid line). The "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line begins at approximately 0.2 and increases to approximately 0.35 by the end of the x-axis. The "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line begins at approximately 0.2 and increases to approximately 0.3 by the end of the x-axis. The second plot displays the training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" (cyan, circle markers, solid line) and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" (red, square markers, solid line). The "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line begins at approximately 0.05 and increases to approximately 0.15 by the end of the x-axis. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line begins at approximately 0.05 and increases to approximately 0.2 by the end of the x-axis.
